title: 84 years together, 13 children and 120+ descendants: The Brazilian couple who held a Guinness record
summary_full: Manoel Angelim Dino and Maria de Sousa Dino tied the knot in 1940 and enjoyed an incredible union lasting nearly 85 years. Their love blossomed into a large family, with 13 children resulting in a remarkable lineage of more than 120 descendants by 2025. The couple earned Guinness World Records' title as the longest-married living couple of different sexes.
